name: 大佬恭迎团宠老祖宗三千岁
original_name: 大佬恭迎团宠老祖宗三千岁
overview: Ancient immortal Yue Lingxi descends into the modern world and discovers the Fu family on the brink of disaster, threatened by dark sorcery and internal betrayal. Armed with three thousand years of cultivation, she shatters sinister traps, punishes villains, and gathers allies—until an approaching catastrophe forces her to make the most difficult decision of her long life.
